_comment: The single source of truth for what brain remembers. Adding a new corpus = one entry here.
install.sh builds config.json in this shape for you. You can also edit it by hand.
⛔ Don't write a path that doesn't exist — that's not an error, it's a silently empty index nobody notices.
_language_note: en · de · es · fr · ja · ko. English if left empty (BRAIN_LANG shows another one once; the OS locale is not used). The settings UI writes here.
_graph_kinds_note: graph_kinds (optional) — the kinds the connection graph colours, up to three, e.g. ["decision", "note"]. Leave it out and the graph colours this corpus's three most common kinds.
_engines_note: ★engines★ — which outside AI model fills each role. Nothing is used until it is named here (or with `brain engines --set`).
embed: gemini · openai · none   judge: gemini · openai · anthropic · none   (openai + base_url = any OpenAI-compatible server, e.g. a local Ollama)
Optional per role: model, base_url, effort. `brain engines` shows what each role sends and where.

sources.name: memory
sources.path: <the folder your notes live in — `brain detect` lists the candidates on this machine>
sources.note: personal memory — the axis a person edits by hand. Heaviest weight.

sources.name: guide
sources.note: per-project rules (⛔ things not to do). A rule outweighs reference material.

sources.name: wiki
sources.note: wiki/notes. Lower this if it duplicates docs a lot, so the duplicate doesn't outrank the original.
